card.name: Pet and animal care text, mixed positions
card.fires_on: Punctuation and linking words inside pet or veterinary health text (dogs, cats, animals), such as a period after a care sentence. It also fires on partway-through spots in drug names like fentanyl or INQOVI.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug brand or generic names in label text.

modes.label: Veterinarian definition
modes.description: A verb in a sentence describing what a veterinarian does for animals.
modes.example: trained to diagnose and<< treat>> diseases and injuries in animals.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward veterinary and pet-related words and away from children-related words.
card.plain: It lights up in pet and animal health writing and nudges the model to talk about veterinary topics rather than children.
